content: Internal Revenue Service, Special Officer Davis speaking. Please confirm your full name for our record verification.
Uh, yes. My name is Rajiv Patel. I got a message saying there was an issue with my taxes?
Mr. Patel, this call is regarding discrepancies in your federal tax filings for the years 2019 through 2022. Our audit division flagged multiple errors connected to your social security number.
Errors? I don't understand, I use a tax prep service. Why would there be problems?
According to our records, you underreported income and failed to pay additional self-employment taxes. Per IRS section 6331, this constitutes a federal offense.
Oh my god. Is this going to affect my H1B visa? I can't lose my job.

Mr. Patel, the IRS treats these violations seriously. Right now, there's a pending legal case against you for unpaid taxes, penalties, and interest totaling $8,745.38. If you do not resolve this immediately, your residency status will be flagged, and you could be referred for removal proceedings.
Please, I can't have that happen. I didn't know about any of this. What can I do?

First, do not interrupt me. I am required to advise you that your bank accounts and assets are scheduled to be frozen within the next 45 minutes. Wage garnishment and a lien on your property will begin unless you satisfy the outstanding amount right now.
No, please! I need my bank account for my salary and rent. Isn't there any other way?

Mr. Patel, if you cooperate, I can put a temporary hold on enforcement actions while we process payment. You must remain on this call. If you disconnect, the system will automatically escalate your case to the criminal division.
Yes, yes, I'm here. I'm not going anywhere.
For immediate resolution, the IRS now accepts secure payments via wire transfer, Zelle, or cryptocurrency. Alternatively, we can process gift card payments if those options are unavailable to you.
I don't have much in savings. How much do I need to pay right now to stop this?
To halt asset seizure, you must pay at least $5,000 today. How much do you have available in your checking account or any credit facilities?
I think I can arrange maybe $3,000 if I transfer from my savings.

That will suffice for a partial settlement. You need to go immediately to the nearest CVS or Walgreens and purchase $3,000 in Target or Apple gift cards. Remain on the line while you do this, do not disconnect under any circumstances.
Gift cards? For the IRS? That doesn't sound right.
This is a temporary protocol due to recent bank fraud cases. My badge number is 84951. Failure to comply will void this arrangement, and agents will be dispatched to your address within the hour.
Okay, okay. I'm leaving right now. Can you stay on the line with me?

Yes, Mr. Patel. Keep this line open at all times. Once you have the cards, give me the numbers and PINs from the back for immediate processing. If you delay, the settlement will be rejected and federal charges will proceed.
